speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you mentioned the newborn has a generalized rash, but I need to ask: Is the baby currently feeding well, and has there been any fever or lethargy noted? REQUEST TEST: CBC, CRP, Blood_Culture.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those results. Since the systemic markers are normal, does the rash appear to be raised, blistered, or present with "dewdrop" lesions on a red base? Please also confirm if any parents or caregivers have a history of similar skin conditions.

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neisseria gonorrhoeae sepsis with disseminated gonococcal infection manifesting as a purulent pustular rash.
